Subject: QuantumPay MSA / Order Form - initial party details & Exhibit A questions

Hi Amparo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited to move forward and want to get the contracting process started so we can line up onboarding and a December pilot. To help our legal team prepare a clean draft and to reduce rounds of redlines, could you confirm the following party-level details and share any internal exhibits you want reflected in the order form?

Quick checklist:
- Exact legal entity name for the contracting counterparty (including DBA if any)
- Primary billing contact (name, email, title)
- Whether you need an SLA in the Order Form or prefer the baseline platform SLA
- Any special data residency or logging requirements (e.g., EU-only retention)
- Whether QuantumPay will require specific indemnity/insurance language beyond our standard

Also — we saw an Exhibit A in your template during the demo referencing a payment-processing addendum. Can you attach the latest Exhibit A (or a redline) so our contracts team can confirm scope and IP carve-outs? If you have a preferred PO or internal procurement form, please attach that too.

I’ve looped in Laura (legal) and Marissa (sales ops) to own party-sheet collection and the initial intake. If it helps we can run a 30-minute intake call this Wednesday to walk through the exhibit together. Proposed window: 11/11 10:00–10:30 PT.

Best,
Jonas

--

Hi Amparo (and Jonas),

Laura from Legal here — thanks for starting this. A couple of things we’ll need to get a clean first-pass redline ready:

1) Full legal entity and registered address for the contracting party (exact spelling as on their certificate of incorporation).
2) Contact for security/compliance evidence requests (SOC2, data flow diagrams).
3) Clarify whether QuantumPay will request logs/audit export frequency different than our default 90-day retention.
4) Any indemnity/insurance riders (we can accept Acord certificate for insurers; limits we typically see are $1M/$2M but we can discuss).

If you can attach the QuantumPay Exhibit A and any SOW, I’ll circulate a marked-up MSA (PDF) and call out items likely to require commercial sign-off (e.g., liability caps, termination for convenience).

On the intake call: 11/11 10:00 PT works from our side; I’ll put a 30-minute invite on the calendar and include a brief agenda: party sheet, Exhibit A review, and a timeline for redlines (target turnaround 3 business days).

Thanks —
Laura
